sloka: रक्षसाम् तु शतम् रामः शतेन एकेन कर्णिना ।सहस्रम् तु सहस्रेण जघान रण मूर्धनि ॥३-२६-३१॥
transliteration: rakṣasām tu śatam rāmaḥ śatena ekena karṇinā ।sahasram tu sahasreṇa jaghāna raṇa mūrdhani ॥3-26-31॥

translations.english: Rama killed a hundred demons with one hundred arrows by a single stroke. The same way he killed a thousand of them with a thousand arrows on the battle front.
